source.quote_free_summary: Registry Events post results at the event, open to all competitors for at least 30 days, including rounds, placements and score reports; judges may be anonymous on the score report at the Event Director/Owner/Chief Judge's discretion; corrected results must be posted.

requirement: The 30-day competitor access, score reports and corrected-result posting are NOT IMPLEMENTED for a future WSDC profile. Judge anonymity is a body-specific event-level choice; no global anonymity policy is set.
enforcement_point: Not built. NOT IMPLEMENTED; a blocker for the corresponding future governing-body profile. The Studio/Custom entrants default is not applied to body profiles.
